modern: He who loves fame considers another man’s activity to be his own good; and he who loves pleasure, his own sensations; but he who has understanding considers his own acts to be his own good.

explained.summary: Someone who loves fame places their good in other people’s actions, in what others say and do about them. Someone who loves pleasure places it in their own sensations. A person with understanding places their good in their own actions, the one thing actually in their hands.
explained.today: If your day is made or ruined by how many people liked your post, your happiness is in strangers’ thumbs. If it depends on the next meal or drink, it’s in your stomach. Measuring the day by how well you acted keeps it in your own hands.
